items.title: Binance sets aside $6.34 billion as analysts tie record hack to North Korea
items.dek: TRM Labs and Chainalysis link the theft to the TraderTraitor unit. Withdrawals stay paused; Binance says customer assets won't be touched.

items.title: Aave freezes all DAO-run V3 and V4 markets after the hacker borrows ETH
items.dek: A wallet tied to the Binance attack posted stolen USDT as collateral and borrowed about 20,000 ETH. Withdrawals and repayments still work.

items.title: Coinbase Q3 profit hits $719 million as revenue falls 35%
items.dek: Almost all of the profit came from gains on crypto it holds. Prediction markets passed $200 million in annualized revenue.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs eke out $17 million inflow as ether funds lose $105 million
items.dek: A fourth straight day of inflows, but far below Wednesday's $137 million as the Binance hack hit prices.
